findings.where: Phone first screen, inside the hairline frame: the order runs portrait, Mark's line, the yellow 'Write to me directly' strip, then the 'I advise multilateral development banks…' paragraph
findings.fault: At 390 px the portrait takes about 310 px above the heading. This pushes the address strip down to the fold, where it is only just in view. The paragraph saying what Mark does and for whom falls below the action, outside the first screen. The desktop order is line, paragraph, action. On the phone the action splits the line from the paragraph that explains it, and the paragraph ends up as a trailing afterthought at the bottom of the frame.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank officer opening the link on a phone. Their first screen shows a face, a broad statement about PPPs and an email address, but nothing saying that Mark advises banks and governments. They are asked to write before they know why they would. The founder judges the first screen first, and would see the phone hero read in a different order from the desktop one.

findings.fault: The four-column table is kept at 390 px. The Element column breaks into four- and seven-line stacks of two or three words per line, and the Easing value wraps mid-function. The row cannot be read as one row, and the table looks crushed next to the open spacing of the rest of the sheet.
findings.who_objects: The founder or Mark reviewing the tile on a phone. The motion sketch is part of the candidate, and here they have to work out which timing goes with which step.

findings.where: Specimen sheet below the fold, desktop: the second-column starts of Palette (third swatch at ~862 px), Type pair (sans specimen at ~927 px) and Texture (notes at ~706 px). The motion curve box also sits ~7 px in from the 426 px content edge its caption keeps, at both widths.
findings.fault: Each specimen section starts its second column on a different line, and the curve box is nudged off the column edge that everything else holds. Continuity down the sheet breaks into a slightly ragged grid, on a direction whose case rests on a document's exactness.
findings.who_objects: A careful reviewer such as the founder, who reads the sheet as evidence that the look is precise. Few visitors would notice.
